recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up profile view of a polished silver fighter jet's tail section, featuring weathered decals, stencil-style identification numbers, and a glowing orange jet exhaust trail against a neutral, hazy sky.
coreVisualRelationships: The metallic sheen of the fuselage reflects the ambient light of the sky.
The horizontal red stripes provide a directional anchor for the motion blur.
The glowing exhaust creates a high-contrast focal point against the cool metal tones.
The decals and typography follow the curved perspective of the aircraft's surface.
coreInvariants: Brushed aluminum texture with visible rivets
Motion blur on the trailing edges of the tail fin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The tail section occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, angled slightly upward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large identification numbers on the mid-fuselage act as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the jet from the nose art on the left, along the fuselage, to the glowing exhaust on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left and bottom areas are filled with a desaturated, atmospheric haze.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool silver and grey metallic tones for the aircraft body.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Matte black for the stencil typography and decals.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for stripes and glowing orange/white for the jet flame.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value highlights on the metal and high-saturation accents in the flame.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for identification numbers
Angular, blocky construction for tail markings
Slight weathering and texture overlay on all glyphs
characterSpecificRedesigns: The '2' features a sharp, flat base and top curve typical of military stencils
The tail text uses a condensed, high-waisted geometric structure
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Combine heavy industrial stencils with condensed geometric sans-serifs for secondary technical markings.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic US Air Force stencil style
Industrial and technical feel for tail markings

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a detailed digital painting of a silver fighter jet tail section with rivets, red stripes, and a glowing orange afterburner flame against a hazy sky. Include motion blur on the right edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply weathered black stencil-style identification numbers to the fuselage and condensed geometric text inside a red diamond on the tail fin, ensuring they follow the perspective of the aircraft.

verificationChecks: Typography follows the 3D curvature of the plane
Texture of the decals matches the weathering of the metal
Motion blur is consistent with the direction of travel

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the jet exhaust glow
Amount of surface weathering and scratches
Specific icons used in the nose art

mustAchieve: Dynamic sense of speed through blur

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic rivet placement along panel lines
Ensure the exhaust flame has a white-hot core
Verify the perspective of the text on the vertical stabilizer
Confirm the motion blur does not obscure the primary subject details
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Metallic Aircraft Subject] + [Industrial Stencil Typography] + [High-Speed Motion Blur] + [Glowing Heat Source] for a dynamic aviation aesthetic.
